profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with strong object-oriented coding abilities, primarily in Java and Coffee Script/JavaScript. Displays a technology-agnostic approach to engineering, and a fast learner of new technologies. Burning desire to solve new and complex problems by designing new systems and algorithms that make any solution more efficient and complete.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed innovative tools to enhance tracking and planning for global datacenter scaling initiatives.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and optimize performance metrics.  
• Implemented automation processes and tools to increase automated ingestion up to 80% of required tasks, improving operational efficiency.

positions.title: Full-time parenting
positions.description: taking a break after my second son was born.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with several engineering teams. to collaborate and implement multiple employee experiences.
Developed, supported, and scaled the MS internal application MyHub mobile for both Android and iOS.
Improved and optimized existing Azure Cloud infrastructure to support multiple backend APIs by configuring disaster recovery support as well as multi-region load balancing.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Mentored more junior engineers, along with helping improve the overall development processes.
Supported and improved a wide range of Backend services and Frontend applications for Groupon Getaways, collaborating with external teams and across different stacks and apps to increase sales by 10%.
Improved functionality and overall design of the supported services and solutions as well as working towards improving the overall architecture of the company.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III
positions.description: Implemented, improved, and supported all Frontend-related Web applications for the Groupon Getaways Business area.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Global Travel Engineering Team
Improved and supported travel platforms currently serving the European market.
Developed new platforms that help integrate new countries into the booking system.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed software platforms for the internal operation of the company. Established modifications on the public site.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Supported the codification and the adoption of new technologies and software tools.
Directed architecture and design the platforms to implement, developing robust and scalable applications.
Defined the database models for the platforms to implement or modify.
Code reviews of other engineers in the area, according to the development processes and standards defined for the software development team.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Leadership of projects to develop platforms for mobile operators, aimed at delivering high-demand services.
Implementation of projects for messaging services (SMS and MMS), billing systems, and services focused on the identification of terminals and recharging prepaid phones.
Integration of systems with Services Oriented Architectures using SOAP and REST Web Services.

positions.title: Research & Development Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created, maintained, and improved software components. Developed mobile applications on Objective-C for iOS and Java for Android.
Codified software components based on the functional and technical design of the application. The codification of the source code was done mainly on Java, using REST architecture.
Developed Web Services over JEE and Web Logic, using Oracle databases and PL/SQL stored procedures.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Web application development using PHP frameworks, XHTML, CSS, Javascript, and MySQL databases. Modification of Java platforms that implement Web Services for OTA configuration of mobile phones.
